items.action: Patch on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator to 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10 or 6.4.2.12 (hosted instances already patched) and update Collabora's Built-in CODE Server to 26.4.303; restrict the VCO portal to trusted management networks and hunt logs for prior access.
items.details: Arista confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-114625, which lets even an Enterprise Read-Only user escalate to superuser operator on on-premises VCO; it is the third VCO flaw weaponized since July. CVE-2026-110447 allows remote code execution via proxy.php when the local CODE server is not running, and attackers have used it to plant web shells on Nextcloud instances.
items.summary: CISA added two actively exploited critical flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Oct 23: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL injection CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9) and Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server command injection CVE-2026-110447 (CVSS 9.2), with an Oct 26 remediation deadline for federal agencies.
items.title: CISA adds VeloCloud and Collabora flaws to KEV; patch by Oct 26

items.action: Patch the cited edge-device flaws, pull management interfaces off the internet, and rotate every credential stored on or reachable via affected appliances — patching alone does not revoke already-stolen keys.
items.details: The actor scanned for exposed edge devices via FOFA and ZoomEye, then exploited CVE-2025-64446 (FortiWeb) and CVE-2026-0257 (PAN-OS) or brute-forced logins, gaining persistent VPN and remote-management access; about 38% of victims were in Asia Pacific. Some victims later appeared on ransomware leak sites linked to Qilin and The Gentlemen.
items.summary: A joint Group-IB and NyxLab investigation published Oct 21 details an access-broker campaign by actor 'k0t' that harvested more than 70,000 credentials and LDAP data from exposed Fortinet FortiGate/FortiWeb and Palo Alto GlobalProtect devices.
items.title: k0t campaign harvested 70,000+ firewall and VPN credentials

items.action: Treat infostealer-exposed credentials as compromised: force resets, revoke sessions, and check for follow-on ransomware deployment.
items.details: Reporting ties the compromise to the 'Cavalier' stealer family, with one employee, four users and nine third-party employee credentials compromised, and 331 exposed passwords identified, 70 of them critical.
items.summary: On Oct 24, the Krybit ransomware group listed Mexican business conglomerate Grupo Euro Corporativo on its leak site, in an incident tracked by Ransomware.live and linked to infostealer activity.
items.title: Krybit lists Mexican conglomerate Grupo Euro Corporativo

items.action: Assume listed data is exposed: notify affected individuals, monitor for publication, and review backups and segmentation before any recovery decision.
items.details: The group, which has about 70 recorded victims, listed archived personal and corporate data of employees and customers.
items.summary: Emperador ransomware listed German fuel distributor Frommann Energie GmbH on its leak site on Oct 24, following a double-extortion model of exfiltration before encryption.
items.title: Emperador lists German energy firm Frommann Energie

items.action: Manufacturers with exposed edge or VPN access should treat ransomware-claim listings as a prompt to verify backups and incident response readiness.
items.details: Penco, based in Greenville, North Carolina, makes steel lockers, shelving and pallet racks used in schools, hospitals and military facilities.
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group listed US steel-locker manufacturer Penco Products on Oct 24, in a claim discovered the same day.
items.title: The Gentlemen claims US manufacturer Penco Products

items.action: SBI customers should never share OTPs, PINs or passwords and should treat unsolicited calls or messages referencing the incident as potential phishing.
items.details: The notice follows SBI's Oct 21 stock-exchange disclosure that preliminary analysis of ~3.75 lakh dark-web records identified 3,897 customer records containing PII, including names, mobile numbers, dates of birth, addresses, branch and CIF identifiers and loan/lead metadata. A detailed investigation into authenticity, source and extent is ongoing.
items.summary: On Oct 23, State Bank of India said it had individually informed every customer whose data was identified as involved in the recent cyber incident, via email and/or WhatsApp, and reiterated that account balances and funds are safe.
items.title: SBI individually notifies customers hit by cyber incident

items.action: Treat any SBI-related loan/account data as potentially circulating; watch for targeted phishing and fraudulent loan applications using KYC documents.
items.details: This follows an earlier claim flagged Oct 16 by OSINT account CyberPulse56 of a threat actor 'Siriusim' claiming ~375,000 CSV rows + 2,722 PDFs allegedly linked to SBI — authenticity unverified and a separate, unconfirmed claim.
items.summary: State Bank of India reported on Oct 21 that a cyberattack led to 3,897 customer records containing personally identifiable information being disclosed on the dark web.
items.title: SBI reports cyberattack; 3,897 customer records on dark web

items.details: The claims remain unverified; SBI had not responded to queries and it is unclear whether the records are genuine or originated from SBI's systems. This is separate from the 3,897-record incident SBI itself reported.
items.summary: On Oct 20, Indian media reported that cybersecurity monitoring account CyberPulse56 flagged a hacker group named 'Siriusim' claiming ~3.75 lakh SBI-linked records in CSV format plus 2,722 PDFs (personal details, loan applications, account-opening forms). Unverified allegation.
items.title: Hacker group 'Siriusim' claims 3.75 lakh SBI records (unverified)

items.action: Site operators relying on eMudhra certificates should watch for revocation and reissuance guidance from browsers and CERT-In.
items.details: MeitY said the incident primarily affected eMudhra's global certificate business and that the impact on Indian websites and applications was 'very limited' and short-lived, following a CERT-In advisory and browser blocks by Google and Mozilla.
items.summary: On Oct 21, MeitY said it had constituted a special team to investigate a security incident at digital certification authority eMudhra, after private keys associated with its globally trusted certificates were reported compromised.
items.title: MeitY sets up special team to probe eMudhra security incident
